title: Zákon č. 297/2016 Sb., o službách vytvářejících důvěru pro elektronické transakce
title_en: Act on Trust Services for Electronic Transactions
description: Czech implementation of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS Regulation) on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market. Establishes the supervisory body and sets national rules for electronic signatures, seals, time stamps, and electronic delivery services.

provisions.title: Subject matter
provisions.content: This Act regulates, in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market (eIDAS Regulation): (a) the conditions for the provision of trust services; (b) the supervisory body for trust services; (c) the use of electronic identification in the public sector; (d) the legal effects of electronic signatures, electronic seals, electronic time stamps, and electronic delivery services.

provisions.title: Definitions
provisions.content: For the purposes of this Act, terms shall have the meaning as defined in Article 3 of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014. In addition: (a) 'Ministry' means the Ministry of the Interior; (b) 'supervisory body' means the Ministry of the Interior in its capacity as the supervisory body for trust services.

provisions.title: Electronic signatures in legal acts
provisions.content: Where legislation requires a written form for a legal act, this requirement is met by a document in electronic form if it is signed with a qualified electronic signature within the meaning of Article 3(12) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014. A qualified electronic signature shall have the equivalent legal effect of a handwritten signature.

provisions.title: Electronic signatures for public authorities
provisions.content: Public authorities shall use qualified electronic signatures when signing electronic documents where a signature is required. Public authorities shall accept qualified electronic signatures based on qualified certificates issued by qualified trust service providers from any EU Member State.

provisions.title: Advanced electronic signatures
provisions.content: An advanced electronic signature that does not meet the requirements of a qualified electronic signature may be used in legal relations unless the law explicitly requires a qualified electronic signature. The evidentiary value of an advanced electronic signature shall be assessed by the court taking into account all circumstances of the case.

provisions.chapter: Part Three — Electronic Seals and Time Stamps
provisions.title: Electronic seals
provisions.content: A qualified electronic seal within the meaning of Article 3(27) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 shall enjoy the presumption of integrity of the data and of the correctness of the origin of those data to which the seal is linked. Public authorities shall use qualified electronic seals to ensure the integrity and origin of electronic documents.

provisions.chapter: Part Three — Electronic Seals and Time Stamps
provisions.title: Electronic time stamps
provisions.content: A qualified electronic time stamp within the meaning of Article 3(34) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 shall enjoy the presumption of the accuracy of the date and time it indicates and of the integrity of the data to which the date and time are bound. Public authorities shall use qualified electronic time stamps where it is necessary to prove the existence of data at a specific point in time.

provisions.title: Qualified electronic delivery services
provisions.content: A qualified electronic delivery service within the meaning of Article 3(37) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 shall enjoy the presumption of the integrity of the data, the sending of those data by the identified sender, and the receipt of those data by the identified addressee. Qualified electronic delivery services shall provide evidence of the sending and receiving of data.

provisions.title: Data boxes
provisions.content: The data box system (datové schránky) established under Act No. 300/2008 Coll. shall be deemed to meet the requirements for a qualified electronic delivery service within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, provided that the conditions for identification of sender and addressee and integrity of data are fulfilled.

provisions.title: Qualified trust service providers
provisions.content: A qualified trust service provider must: (a) meet the requirements set out in Article 24 of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014; (b) be established in the Czech Republic or in another EU Member State; (c) be included in the national trusted list maintained by the supervisory body. The supervisory body shall grant qualified status after verifying compliance with the requirements.

provisions.title: Conformity assessment
provisions.content: Qualified trust service providers shall undergo a conformity assessment by a conformity assessment body accredited under Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 at least every 24 months. The conformity assessment report shall be submitted to the supervisory body.

provisions.title: National trusted list
provisions.content: The supervisory body maintains and publishes the national trusted list of qualified trust service providers and the qualified trust services they provide, in accordance with Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.

provisions.title: Electronic identification for public services
provisions.content: Where access to an online service provided by a public authority requires electronic identification, the authority shall accept electronic identification means issued under a notified electronic identification scheme of any EU Member State, provided the scheme meets the assurance level required for the service. The National Identification Authority administers the electronic identification framework.

provisions.title: National electronic identification
provisions.content: Czech national electronic identification is provided through the National Point for Identification and Authentication (NIA) and the eGovernment system. Citizens may authenticate using: (a) the electronic identity card (eObčanka); (b) the data box system; (c) other means meeting the required assurance level.

provisions.title: Supervisory body
provisions.content: The Ministry of the Interior acts as the supervisory body for trust services within the meaning of Article 17 of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014. The supervisory body: (a) supervises qualified trust service providers established in the Czech Republic; (b) maintains the national trusted list; (c) takes supervisory measures, including suspension or withdrawal of qualified status.

provisions.title: Inspections
provisions.content: The supervisory body may conduct inspections of qualified trust service providers to verify compliance with Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 and this Act. During an inspection, the supervisory body may require the provider to submit documents, records, and data necessary for the verification.

provisions.title: Administrative offences
provisions.content: A trust service provider commits an administrative offence by: (a) providing qualified trust services without being included in the national trusted list; (b) failing to undergo a conformity assessment; (c) failing to notify the supervisory body of a security breach. Fines may be imposed up to CZK 10,000,000.

provisions.title: Security breach notification
provisions.content: A qualified trust service provider shall notify the supervisory body without undue delay of any breach of security or loss of integrity that has a significant impact on the trust service provided, in accordance with Article 19 of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.

provisions.title: Repealing provisions
provisions.content: Act No. 227/2000 Coll., on Electronic Signatures (zákon č. 227/2000 Sb., o elektronickém podpisu), is hereby repealed.

provisions.title: Effectiveness
provisions.content: This Act shall enter into force on 19 September 2016.

definitions.definition: An advanced electronic signature that is created by a qualified electronic signature creation device and is based on a qualified certificate for electronic signatures, as defined in Article 3(12) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.
The data box system established under Act No. 300/2008 Coll. for electronic delivery of official documents between public authorities and citizens/businesses.
Národní bod pro identifikaci a autentizaci (National Point for Identification and Authentication) — the Czech national electronic identification gateway.
